test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In November 2022, which of the following Union Ministries has launched a month-long campaign titled, 'Nai Chetna-Pahal Badlav Ki' - A Community-led National Campaign against Gender-Based Discrimination?

options.text: Ministry of Women and Child Development
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

solution:
The correct option is __**Ministry of Rural Development**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Nai Chetna-Pahal Badlav Ki**

 
• The campaign aims to sensitize rural communities across India on issues related to gender-based discrimination and** promote gender equality**.
 
• The campaign will be led by **women's self-help groups**, who will conduct various activities such as rallies, street plays, and awareness sessions.
 
• The **Ministry of Rural Development** has allocated Rs. 50 crore for the campaign, which will be implemented in collaboration with state governments and other stakeholders.
 
• The campaign is part of the government's efforts to empower women in rural areas and promote their participation in development activities.
